verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official CLI (sentry-docs-4/24, sentry-probe-4) explicitly used for tasks like uploading source maps, managing releases, and associating commits — workflows that are typically run headlessly in CI pipelines — and SDKs are 'dropped in' without agents to install (sentry-docs-1/12), supporting automation-friendly monitoring. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, pipeline examples, or hands-on evidence confirming headless CI usage patterns. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration guides/examples, independent confirmation of headless CI usage, and any CI-specific automation docs beyond CLI reference pages.
